description: This file defines the SlidingTabStrip class, a custom view extending LinearLayout, used for rendering tab indicators, underlines, and dividers in a tab layout component within an Android application.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom view for rendering tab indicators, underlines, and dividers in a tab layout.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface for providing indicator and divider colors for tabs.

classes.name: SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: Default implementation of TabColorizer used within SlidingTabStrip.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom TabColorizer for tab coloring.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the selected tab indicator.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the dividers between tabs.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset, then redraws.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the tab indicator, underline, and dividers.

methods.name: setColorAlpha
methods.description: Utility to set alpha transparency of a color.

methods.name: blendColors
methods.description: Utility to blend two colors based on a ratio.
